question: Has gap G001 already been addressed: No retrieval benchmark evaluates version selection over continuously amended legal text at clause granularity: no resource pairs time-stamped queries with ground-truth in-force versions of overlapping, near-duplicate amended clauses and measures retrieval of superseded or not-yet-in-force text. Legal-domain temporal work is either conceptual/prescriptive (explicitly without empirical comparison) or multiple-choice over normative-act relationships without source-text retrieval; temporal retrieval benchmarks with temporal-accuracy metrics exist only for ESG disclosures and financial filings; regulatory retrieval benchmarks have no target dates at all.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
